subject.title: fix(gateway): cap pendingFinalDelivery retries and prevent delivery wedge

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's restart-recovery-only 10-attempt dead-letter policy for pending final deliveries, or should pending-final abandonment wait for the broader TTL/attempt policy tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85743?
rationale: Clearing `pendingFinalDelivery` after a cap can unblock wedged sessions but can also drop a recoverable final reply, and the exact threshold is a product/operations policy rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept bounded restart dead-lettering
options.body: Keep this PR's narrow restart-recovery cap after the timestamp guard, regression coverage, and real behavior proof are added.

options.title: Require broader TTL policy first
options.body: Pause this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85743 defines one canonical attempt/age policy for heartbeat, restart, and reaper paths.

options.title: Do not dead-letter automatically
options.body: Reject automatic abandonment and require an operator-facing recovery or diagnostic path before clearing pending finals.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded restart dead-lettering
recommendation.body: Keep this PR's narrow restart-recovery cap after the timestamp guard, regression coverage, and real behavior proof are added.
